skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply vocabulary, sentence patterns, background knowledge, strategies, and listening skills to comprehend daily familiar topics as well as unfamiliar topics.
Use English relatively fluently in social interactions about familiar topics.
Acquire vocabulary, grammar structures, and dialogue models related to various topics at the B1 level.
Develop critical thinking, technology-based information search, synthesis, and analysis skills to solve problems related to different topics.

Demonstrate the ability to work independently, conduct self-study, show personal responsibility, and work in teams; express and defend personal opinions based on objective scientific approaches; demonstrate social responsibility when making judgments and evaluations.
